sites.meaning: Before BL HomeTop.HomeEnterAsync; request begins, not response completion.
Before BL OutGame3D.ChangeEnvironmentAsync(type2); this branch is camera state, not a scene asset await.
Background scene await returned and IsLoadingScene=false was stored; virtual AfterLoadEnvironmentAsync has not run yet, actors are not guaranteed ready.
OnDispose already wrote IsEndShaderWarmUp=true; cleanup gate released, not proof shaders succeeded.
Before HomePageGroup.OnOpenInAsync call, after shader wait gate.
Before LoadingManager.Hide call, not proof complete home visibility.
After HomeFrontLoadingView.FinishLoading returned; before later HomeTop.ShowInAsync await, not whole-home completion.
UniTaskExtensions.GetAwaiter for four-motion join; join examined, not proof it suspended.
Before SolisActorUtility.UpdateCacheActorAsync call after cache miss.
Cache-hit or successful cache-build merge; actor available before further setup/fade.
Before UniTask.WaitWhile(cache-busy predicate); not proof waiting duration.
HomeTop.ShowInAsync await has returned; next call is NotificationManager.Resume, then separate HomeEntering/tutorial work.
Reached only when shader completion flag was false: before UniTask.WaitUntil for IsEndShaderWarmUp. Does not read/write context or flag. Later home_open_begin proves this gate passed.
